<section>
<div class="maincontents">
<div class="pagetit">
<h1 class="pagetit">館内紹介</h1>
</div><!-- / .pagetit -->
<div class="inn-fr">
<!-- contents -->
<div id="contentstxt">
<p class="underline wp-block-paragraph">遊びから帰ったらそのままシャワー・道具のケアも済ませられる！そんな設備を用意しました。</p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">屋外シャワー室/屋外トイレ</h2>
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-8f761849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-gallery has-nested-images columns-default is-cropped wp-block-gallery-1 is-layout-flex wp-block-gallery-is-layout-flex">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><a href="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/floor_photo01a.jpg"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="280" height="260" data-id="469" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/floor_photo01a.jpg" alt="そのままシャワーやトイレを利用できる屋外設備" class="wp-image-469"/></a></figure>
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><a href="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/floor_photo01.jpg"><img decoding="async" width="280" height="260" data-id="468" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/floor_photo01.jpg" alt="屋外シャワー" class="wp-image-468"/></a><figcaption class="wp-element-caption"> 屋外シャワー </figcaption></figure>
</figure>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">マリンスポーツやロードバイクの後、そのままシャワーやトイレ（温水洗浄機能付）を利用できる屋外設備。</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">屋外シャワー×2、トイレ×1</p>
</div>
</div>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">洗い場・干場</h2>
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-8f761849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">ウェットスーツや道具の洗い場・屋外洗濯機もご自由にご利用いただけます。</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">※各部屋専用の鍵付きマリンロッカー（干場）</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">※洗濯機は手ぶらで安心の洗剤自動投入タイプです。</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">※ご自由にお使いいただけるバスタオル類をご用意してます。</p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-gallery has-nested-images columns-default is-cropped wp-block-gallery-2 is-layout-flex wp-block-gallery-is-layout-flex">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><a href="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180902.jpg"><img decoding="async" width="768" height="1024" data-id="1185" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180902-768x1024.jpg" alt="屋外洗濯機" class="wp-image-1185" srcset="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180902-768x1024.jpg 768w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180902-225x300.jpg 225w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180902-1152x1536.jpg 1152w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180902.jpg 1330w" sizes="(max-width: 768px) 100vw, 768px" /></a><figcaption class="wp-element-caption"> 屋外洗濯機 </figcaption></figure>
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><a href="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180905.jpg"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="768" height="1024" data-id="1187" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180905-768x1024.jpg" alt="各部屋専用の鍵付きマリンロッカー（干場）" class="wp-image-1187" srcset="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180905-768x1024.jpg 768w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180905-225x300.jpg 225w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180905-1152x1536.jpg 1152w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/line_oa_chat_210827_180905.jpg 1330w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 768px) 100vw, 768px" /></a><figcaption class="wp-element-caption"> マリンロッカー </figcaption></figure>
</figure>
<figure class="wp-block-gallery has-nested-images columns-default is-cropped wp-block-gallery-3 is-layout-flex wp-block-gallery-is-layout-flex">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-medium"><a href="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1063-scaled.jpg"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="300" height="225" data-id="1305" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1063-300x225.jpg" alt="バスタオル類ご用意してます" class="wp-image-1305" srcset="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1063-300x225.jpg 300w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1063-1024x768.jpg 1024w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1063-768x576.jpg 768w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1063-1536x1152.jpg 1536w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1063-2048x1536.jpg 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 300px) 100vw, 300px" /></a></figure>
</figure>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div>
</div>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">メンテナンスルーム</h2>
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-8f761849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="280" height="260" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/floor_photo03.jpg" alt="エアコン完備のメンテンナンスルーム" class="wp-image-1071"/></figure>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">ロードバイク等のお手入れ、保管にご利用いただけます。</p>
<figure class="wp-block-gallery has-nested-images columns-default is-cropped wp-block-gallery-4 is-layout-flex wp-block-gallery-is-layout-flex">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><a href="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/floor_photo03a.jpg"><img decoding="async" data-id="476" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/floor_photo03a.jpg" alt="屋外からスロープでメンテンナンスルームへ" class="wp-image-476"/></a><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">屋外からからの出入口</figcaption></figure>
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><a href="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/floor_photo03b.jpg"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="280" height="260" data-id="482" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/floor_photo03b.jpg" alt="受付ロビーからの出入り口" class="wp-image-482"/></a><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">受付ロビーからの出入口</figcaption></figure>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">食堂</h2>
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-8f761849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">　<strong>朝食</strong>　<strong>1,000円</strong>　7：30～（和食）</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">　<strong>夕食　1,500円</strong>　18：30～ 　木・日曜休み</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">　FUNBASE Kitchenのページに献立を表示しています。</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">　仕入れの都合で変更になることもあります。</p>
<p class="has-vivid-red-color has-text-color wp-block-paragraph"><strong>要予約（前日迄）　✆080-8009-5050</strong></p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1024" height="768" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1046-1024x768.jpg" alt="ちいさな食堂『FUNBASE Kitchen』" class="wp-image-1316" srcset="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1046-1024x768.jpg 1024w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1046-300x225.jpg 300w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1046-768x576.jpg 768w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1046-1536x1152.jpg 1536w, https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/IMG_1046-2048x1536.jpg 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">コミュニティスペース</h2>
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-8f761849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">保管庫(艇庫)</h2>
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-8f761849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="280" height="260" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/floor_photo05.jpg" alt="用具預かりサービス│俺カゴ" class="wp-image-1050"/></figure>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">当館をご利用いただいているお客様の大切な海道具をお預かりします。</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><i class="fas fa-arrow-circle-right"></i><a href="https://funbase.jp/fee/#teiko" title="保管庫(艇庫)料金表">料金表</a></p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><i class="fas fa-arrow-circle-right"></i><a href="https://funbase.jp/floorguide/teiko-rule/">用具預かりサービスと規約</a></p>
<figure class="wp-block-image size-large"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="300" height="50" src="https://funbase.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/servicepoint.png" alt="ファンベースうるまはこんなサービスも♪" class="wp-image-285"/></figure>
<p class="sc_05 underline wp-block-paragraph">保管庫ご利用のお客様は、マリンロッカーに干した用具（ウェットスーツ等）が乾いたら、スタッフが保管庫に移動するサービス付き！時間ギリギリまでマリンスポーツを楽しんでください♪</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div>
</div>
